tool_policy.fallback_authorization: BK explicitly authorized built-in Codex imagegen continuation when OPENAI_API_KEY could not be configured in the remote SSH environment.
tool_policy.transparent_asset_method: Each sprite or UI source used an explicitly requested flat #ff00ff chroma-key background. The imagegen remove_chroma_key.py helper ran through uv with Pillow using border auto-key sampling, soft matte, thresholds 12/220, and despill. The background layer was copied directly because it intentionally has no alpha.

visual_contract.hierarchy: Player > Goal > Hazard = Item > Safe platform > HUD/status > Background
visual_contract.silhouette_rule: Hazard is a jagged triangular spike cluster; item is a rounded seed-relic droplet; goal is a tall halo-and-monolith beacon; platform is a broad horizontal slab; player is a compact hooded body.
visual_contract.background_rule: One coherent low-contrast Background World Layer with no usable platform, hazard, collectible, goal, character, UI, text, or foreground-prop read.

license_or_usage_note: Generated by Codex built-in image_gen under the authorized ChatGPT access path. These assets are prototype-only, production-candidate review material. No asset is production-approved; rights review and any required human final pass remain gates before public or launch use.

prompts.prompt: Create one coherent calm background-only world layer for a 2D side-scrolling platformer: distant dreamy twilight cliff-and-ruin landscape, soft rock silhouettes, faint ruin arches, misty far mountains, quiet sky, a wide 16:9 composition with open low-contrast middle and lower play space. Hand-painted 2D style in muted indigo, dusty teal, desaturated violet, and soft slate. No foreground platforms/floors/landable ledges, spikes, crystals, coins, keys, pickups, gates, portals, doors, flags, lamps, signs, characters, enemies, UI, text, logos, frames, or watermark; no high-contrast accents or visual clutter.
prompts.post_processing: Copied directly; alpha is not required.

prompts.prompt: Create one compact controllable player avatar: a friendly explorer with a large teal hood, warm cream face window, short boots, and a small golden-orange scarf. Full body, centered with generous padding, crisp rounded-triangular silhouette, no weapon, tool, wings, pet, vehicle, or effects. Generate on a perfectly flat #ff00ff chroma-key background with no shadow, floor, texture, gradient, text, logo, or watermark; do not use magenta in the character.

Create one unmistakable goal/destination beacon: a large warm-gold circular halo held by a stone pedestal, an upright deep-indigo monolith inside, and one small pale-cyan center glow. Tall, centered, and clearly unlike a pickup, hazard, or platform. Generate on a perfectly flat #ff00ff chroma-key background with no shadow, floor, particles, text, logo, watermark, character, coin, key, gem, spike, crystal, or platform; do not use magenta in the marker.

Create one static environmental hazard marker: a compact cluster of three sharp asymmetric red-orange obsidian spikes rising from a small dark-charcoal stone base. Its silhouette must be aggressively triangular and jagged, not a pickup, character, platform, or destination. Generate on a perfectly flat #ff00ff chroma-key background with no shadow, floor, flame, smoke, particles, text, logo, watermark, character, weapon, or magenta in the marker.

Create one compact collectible/progression item: a lime-green faceted seed relic shaped as a rounded hexagonal droplet with two short leaf-like fins and a pale non-letter center facet. It must look collectible but not currency, a key, star, heart, crystal cluster, weapon, or goal beacon. Generate on a perfectly flat #ff00ff chroma-key background with no shadow, floor, particles, text, logo, watermark, or magenta in the item.

Create one safe walkable platform tile: a broad low dark-slate rectangular stone slab, gently beveled moss-green top edge, clean flat walkable upper surface, chunky blocky sides, and no sharp points. Generate on a perfectly flat #ff00ff chroma-key background with no shadow, floor, text, logo, watermark, characters, pickups, spikes, gates, portals, or magenta in the platform.

Create one empty status-panel background: a wide rounded-rectangle HUD plaque with a deep-indigo central surface, antique brass trim, two tiny teal corner studs, and a clean empty center for overlay timer, item, result, and retry text. Generate on a perfectly flat #ff00ff chroma-key background with no shadow, text, letters, numbers, icons, logo, watermark, characters, gameplay objects, or magenta in the panel.
